actions.add_rows.description: Add rows to a Floqer workflow sheet, and optionally run them through its actions.
actions.add_rows.props.rows.description: Each row is an object whose keys are the sheet's input column names. Up to 1000 rows per call.
actions.add_rows.props.runAfterAdd.descr: What to run once the rows are written. Only the rows added by this step are affected.
actions.add_rows.props.runAfterAdd.optio: Run every added row (full credit cost)
actions.add_rows.props.sheetId.descripti: The sheet inside the selected workflow.
actions.add_rows.props.workflowId.descri: The Floqer workflow that owns the sheet.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.run_rows.description: Queue rows on a Floqer sheet through its action chain.
actions.run_rows.props.mode.description: Which rows on the sheet to queue.
actions.run_rows.props.mode.options.opti: The first 10 rows on the sheet
actions.run_rows.props.rowIds.descriptio: Row UUIDs to queue. Add Rows returns these as `row_ids`. Ignored unless "Specific row IDs" is selected.
actions.run_rows.props.sheetId.descripti: The sheet inside the selected workflow.
actions.run_rows.props.workflowId.descri: The Floqer workflow that owns the sheet.
actions.run_shortcut.description: Run a published Floqer shortcut and return its result.
actions.run_shortcut.props.shortcutId.de: Published Floqer shortcuts you can run.
auth.description: Your Floqer API key. It starts with `floq_`. Create one from your workspace settings in [Floqer](https://app.floqer.com).
description: Run Floqer shortcuts and push rows into workflow sheets.
